summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Granites and Product Types features for The Tile Shop invoicing application. All 16 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed all features working correctly including Granites Management CRUD, Product Type dropdown (Tiles Box, Tile Pieces, Granite), dynamic form fields, and line item type badges.

minor.issue: PDF route was defined AFTER generic invoice route, causing 404 errors. Fixed by moving PDF routes before generic routes.

critical_code_review_comments: PDF endpoint route ordering bug was found and fixed - routes using {invoice_id:path}/pdf must be defined BEFORE {invoice_id:path} to avoid path matching issues in FastAPI
updated_files: /app/backend/main.py - Fixed PDF route ordering by moving PDF endpoints before generic invoice endpoints
seed_data_creation: Test granites and invoices created during testing with TEST_ prefix for easy identification
